about.title: About me
about.text: I am driven by curiosity and the passion for turning complex challenges into simply useful solutions. Independent while enjoying collaboration, I make sure to combine rigor and a down-to-earth mindset so that every project has a tangible impact. Outside the digital world, I find my inspiration in photography, travel and hiking, permanent sources of creativity and sharp analysis. Quadrilingual and open to the diversity of cultures, I bring an adaptable and enthusiastic outlook to any new adventure.
